name: contract-risk-review

en.description: Review a supplied contract from a stated party and business purpose, add clause-level risk comments without changing the source text, and produce a traceable issue register, objective summary, and escalation list.

zh-CN.description: 基于指定合同版本和审查立场生成有条款定位的风险、理由与修改建议。

runtime: No bundled credentials or service runtime; task-specific document, browser, file, or validation tools optional

stableBlockers: Measure routing, unsupported-claim, and validation-failure rates
Verify target-runtime behavior and recovery paths
